title: Get the right app for the trip
drDigitalIntro:
Dr. Digital wants to know the weather at the destination, and the computer is short on space.
There are no step-by-step instructions here. You get a list of things to accomplish and you decide how.
• Nothing glows yellow. No control is highlighted.
• Do the objectives in any order.
• Open the checklist with the small arrow in the dark bar to see what is left.
• The Hint button gives a nudge toward where to look — never the answer.

Read what an app asks for before you agree to it.

playgroundTask.goal: You installed what was needed and removed what was not
playgroundTask.hint: Searching finds an app faster than browsing categories. Apps you already have are not in the store — they are in a separate list.

steps.say: The weather app's page is open.
You read what it asked for and agreed.
You are looking at what is already on the computer, not the store.
A game nobody plays is no longer taking up space.

drDigitalSuccess: You searched, checked the permissions, installed what was wanted and freed space by removing what was not.
drDigitalHint: The search box is at the top. Once something is installed it moves out of the store into your own list — look for the tab that says so.
